data.content_ref: inline:The abstraction claim is vacuous as a substantive relation: asserting that a fully-constrained system has a singleton fixed point is just the definition of a unique solution, so saying the closure's fixed point is {(44,46,48)} adds no relation between artifacts — it restates that the constraints uniquely determine the answer. The 'refuted if no countercondition can be re-expressed as a closure violation' condition is unfalsifiable because any counterexample can be labeled a constraint violation by fiat, so it never tests whether the closure framing has explanatory power over the individual mechanisms it claims to abstract over.
